classification: SCRIPTED_TEAM_EXPLORATORY. ROLE-COMPOSITION SWEEP AT 6v6. PPO OFF. GPU OFF. CPU ONLY.
authorized_by: PI direction 2026-09-19: held-out opponent validation is parked as optional later robustness work. Main line is 4v4 confirmed -> 6v6. Derive the 6v6 composition strategy first; adapt the guarded router only afterwards.
RESEARCH_QUESTION: At 6v6, under the certified A and B opponent poles, does changing the fixed team composition from 6A/0D through 0A/6D produce pole-dependent outcome differences, and which composition does each pole prefer?
WHY_THIS_AND_NOT_THE_ROUTER_YET: The 4v4 router routes between 2A/2D and 4A/0D because the 4v4 sweep showed those are the per-pole preferred compositions. The analogous 6v6 pair is unknown and cannot be guessed: defender counts do not scale by proportion in this environment, and the defender-assignment machinery changes with team size. The router is adapted only after this sweep names the compositions it should route between.
DIRECT_ANALOGUE: Mirrors PYQUATICUS_4V4_ROLE_COMPOSITION_SWEEP_SPEC.json in structure, estimands, decision labels and telemetry, so the two scales are directly comparable. Deviations are listed explicitly below rather than left implicit.

POLE_DEFINITIONS_AND_THE_ONE_REAL_DISCRE.certification_result: delta_A mean +0.265625 LCB95 +0.09375; delta_B mean +0.625 LCB95 +0.484375; gate LCB95(delta_A) > 0 AND LCB95(delta_B) > 0 -- both pass.

THE_DISCREPANCY_POLE_B_IS_NOT_THE_SAME_A.4v4_pole_B: OP7 plus the B3-3 CANDIDATE genome SDS2_B3_LOCKDEF10_2V1 -- overlay lock_defender=10, enable_2v1=true, min_alive_for_defender=4
THE_DISCREPANCY_POLE_B_IS_NOT_THE_SAME_A.6v6_pole_B: canonical OP7 with size normalization only -- lock_defender=28, enable_2v1=false, min_alive_for_defender=6
THE_DISCREPANCY_POLE_B_IS_NOT_THE_SAME_A.verified_live: resolve_pole_genome('B', 6) returns genome_id SDS_PARENT_OP7 with overlay {min_alive_for_defender: 6}; the live resolved profile reads lock_defender=28, enable_2v1=False.
THE_DISCREPANCY_POLE_B_IS_NOT_THE_SAME_A.consequence: 'the same A/B regimes' is NOT literally true across scales. The 6v6 Pole B is a weaker-locked, non-2v1 fortress relative to the 4v4 Pole B. Any statement that a 6v6 composition result 'reproduces' or 'fails to reproduce' the 4v4 one is confounded by this difference and must say so.
THE_DISCREPANCY_POLE_B_IS_NOT_THE_SAME_A.why_the_certified_poles_are_used_anyway: They are the only 6v6 poles with a frozen certification, and that certification passes both gates. Porting B3-3 to 6v6 would create an uncertified pole and would require its own certification run first -- a larger, separate piece of work.
THE_DISCREPANCY_POLE_B_IS_NOT_THE_SAME_A.alternative_if_the_PI_prefers_scale_matc: Certify a 6v6 B3-3-equivalent pole first, then run this sweep against it. That is the only way to make the two scales' Pole B comparable, and it must be chosen now rather than after seeing results.

COMPOSITIONS.rule: exhaustive over defender count, mirroring the 4v4 sweep's exhaustive five
COMPOSITIONS.baseline: 3A_3D -- the balanced composition, the 6v6 analogue of the 4v4 baseline 2A_2D. Declared now, before any episode.
COMPOSITIONS.canonical_assignment: FIXED_IDENTITY_PREFIX_DEFENDERS, unchanged from 4v4: for defender count D, stable ids 0..D-1 are DEFEND and the rest ATTACK, computed once at reset and held for the episode. No reassignment.
COMPOSITIONS.no_subset_chosen: All seven are run. Selecting 'sensible' counts would be agent discretion over the very quantity the sweep exists to measure.

EXECUTION.adapter_contract: unchanged from 4v4: ATTACK with no friendly carrier -> GET_FLAG; ATTACK with any friendly carrier -> GO_HOME; DEFEND -> unified macro id 7 with live target re-derivation
EXECUTION.why_20500001_and_not_20400001: 20400001 and 20400007 were touched by 4v4 prototyping during the parked held-out design. Those were different-opponent 4v4 episodes and no held-out outcome was read, but a block that has never been touched costs nothing and keeps 'fresh' unambiguous.
EXECUTION.cells: 2 poles x 7 compositions = 14 paired cells; 14 x 64 = 896 episodes
EXECUTION.measured_cost: 12.7 s per 6v6 episode on this machine (prototyped on smoke seed 99900611, both poles, 3A_3D). 896 episodes is about 3.2 hours serial.
EXECUTION.why_n_64: Mirrors the 4v4 sweep exactly, which is what makes the two scales comparable. See the power disclosure below for what n=64 can and cannot resolve.

PREDECLARED_ESTIMANDS_AND_DECISION_RULES.primary_per_cell: Blue win rate, score difference, draw rate, episode length and role telemetry, with 95% paired-seed bootstrap intervals.
PREDECLARED_ESTIMANDS_AND_DECISION_RULES.composition_effect: For each pole, compare every non-3A/3D composition against the frozen 3A/3D baseline on win rate and score difference, paired by seed.
PREDECLARED_ESTIMANDS_AND_DECISION_RULES.regime_effect: Paired B-minus-A contrasts for every composition. Descriptive regime contrasts, not a new strategic-demand certification.
PREDECLARED_ESTIMANDS_AND_DECISION_RULES.regime_composition_signal: A conservative descriptive signal requires a non-baseline composition whose win-rate contrast versus 3A/3D has OPPOSITE SIGNS on Pole A and Pole B, with BOTH pole-specific intervals excluding zero. Otherwise report no demonstrated regime-dependent composition signal.

DERIVATION_DELIVERABLE_THE_ACTUAL_POINT_.quantity: for each pole, the argmax composition by win rate, reported with its paired contrast against the runner-up composition and against the 3A/3D baseline
DERIVATION_DELIVERABLE_THE_ACTUAL_POINT_.why_this_is_the_deliverable: The next step needs to know WHICH two compositions a 6v6 router would switch between. That is an argmax, and it is answerable at n=64 even where the strong label is not. It is declared here so it cannot be presented later as a post-hoc reframing of a weak result.
DERIVATION_DELIVERABLE_THE_ACTUAL_POINT_.not_a_gate: The argmax is descriptive. It does not authorize a router, a confirmation, or 6v6 PPO by itself.
DERIVATION_DELIVERABLE_THE_ACTUAL_POINT_.frozen_statement: For each certified 6v6 pole, identify the empirically best-performing ATTACK/DEFEND composition among all seven compositions, with paired uncertainty reported for contrasts against the 3A/3D baseline and against relevant neighbouring and top compositions.

PREDECLARED_ESTIMANDS_AND_DECISION_RULES.multiplicity: All contrasts are exploratory. 7 compositions x 2 poles with unadjusted intervals. A nominal interval exclusion does not authorize PPO, architecture selection or a router by itself.

POWER_DISCLOSURE_STATED_BEFORE_THE_RUN.what_happened_at_4v4: The 4v4 sweep returned COMPOSITION_DESCRIPTIVE_SIGNAL, not the stronger REGIME_DEPENDENT_COMPOSITION_SIGNAL. Its regime_gate_details show 4A_0D and 3A_1D both had opposite signs with the B interval excluding zero, and the A interval NOT excluding zero in either case. The A side was the binding constraint.
POWER_DISCLOSURE_STATED_BEFORE_THE_RUN.why: The 4v4 Pole-A contrast was small: 4A_0D minus 2A_2D had a paired mean of -0.0938 with 13 positive and 19 negative discordant pairs out of 64.
POWER_DISCLOSURE_STATED_BEFORE_THE_RUN.planning_arithmetic: Resampling that observed 4v4 paired vector to larger n gives a probability the A interval excludes zero of about 0.20 at n=64, 0.34 at n=128, 0.47 at n=192 and 0.61 at n=256. For the smaller 3A_1D contrast (-0.0312) it stays below 0.16 even at n=256.
POWER_DISCLOSURE_STATED_BEFORE_THE_RUN.honest_consequence: If the 6v6 Pole-A effect is the same size as the 4v4 one, the strong REGIME_DEPENDENT_COMPOSITION_SIGNAL label is unlikely at n=64 and is not reliably reachable at any practical n. n=256 would cost 7 x 2 x 256 = 3584 episodes, about 12.6 hours, for roughly a 61 percent chance on one contrast.
POWER_DISCLOSURE_STATED_BEFORE_THE_RUN.this_is_planning_arithmetic_not_a_predic: It assumes the 6v6 Pole-A effect matches the 4v4 one, which is unknown and is part of what the sweep measures. The 6v6 effect could be larger, in which case n=64 resolves it.
POWER_DISCLOSURE_STATED_BEFORE_THE_RUN.recommendation: Run at n=64 and expect the descriptive label. The derivation deliverable above -- the per-pole argmax -- is what the next step actually consumes, and the B-side contrasts were decisive at n=64 at 4v4. Raising n to chase the strong label buys a coin flip on one contrast for four times the compute.
POWER_DISCLOSURE_STATED_BEFORE_THE_RUN.if_the_PI_wants_the_strong_label: It must be chosen now, before any seed is spent, and the honest expectation is roughly even odds at n=256.

CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C1_TEAM_SIZE_IS_REALLY_SIX: Construct the env and read the actual observation shape back, per experiments/team_size.py. A silently-wrong team size does not crash; it runs the wrong experiment.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C2_GENERALIZED_HELPERS_MATCH_THE_4V4_ONE: composition_roles_n and action_for_roles_n must reproduce the frozen 4v4 composition_roles and _action_for_roles EXACTLY for every 4v4 composition. This is the parity check that keeps the two scales comparable; a generalized helper that differs at n=4 would make every cross-scale statement wrong.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C3_POLE_RESOLVES_AS_CERTIFIED: For both poles the LIVE resolved behaviour-tree profile must equal the 6v6 certification's recorded fields on every field it names (min_alive_for_defender, defender_zone_frac, threat_radius). Assert the runtime object, not the requested key.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C4_COMPOSITION_COVERS_THE_TEAM: For every composition, attacker count plus defender count equals 6 and the identity prefix rule holds.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C5_ACTION_VOCABULARY: every emitted macro id is below the evaluation-only n_macros=8.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C6_TERMINAL_SCORING_NOT_RESET_STATE: scores read from info['episode_result'] at the instant done fires, never from core after auto-reset.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C7_NO_PPO_REACHABLE: no PPO, trainer or optimizer module imported.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C8_SEED_BLOCK_OWNED: the block is registered to this experiment, exact range, RESERVED, checked with experiment_id.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.on_failure: CONTRACT_FAILURE, stop, no seed spent. Diagnose against the frozen reference before editing anything.

SEALING.rule_7: This sweep is exploratory, not confirmatory, but it produces outcome rows, so it seals via experiments/run_state.py::seal with AuditPlan.experiment_id supplied.

ISOLATION.only_changed_factor: number of ATTACK versus DEFEND roles under the frozen identity ordering, at team size 6
held_identical_from_4v4: the GET_FLAG / GO_HOME / unified DEFEND adapter
map, rules, horizon, speed intent, telemetry and statistics
forbidden: the guarded router (it is not run in this sweep)
adapter or opponent selection from outcomes
adapting the router before this sweep is interpreted

SEQUENCING_LOCK: 1. PI approves this draft; status becomes FROZEN_BEFORE_SEED_ALLOCATION.
2. Run contracts only. No seed spent.
3. Allocate the block after contracts pass.
4. Run the 14 paired CPU cells and seal.
5. Interpret before proposing a 6v6 router, a 6v6 confirmation, or any PPO.
claim_ceiling: This tests fixed scripted role composition at 6v6 in this project's CTF dynamics, under the certified 6v6 poles. It does not reproduce native Pyquaticus performance, establish learned roles, identify a causal PPO repair, authorize a 6v6 router, or transfer the 4v4 router's confirmed result to 6v6. Cross-scale comparison is additionally confounded by the Pole-B discrepancy recorded above.

PI_DECISIONS_FROZEN_2026_09_19.poles: Certified 6v6 pole pair. Do NOT certify a 6v6 B3-3 equivalent first -- that is another branch with its own compute and design choices, and it is not worth spending before we learn whether composition is even useful at 6v6. If a clean scale-controlled comparison is needed later, the matched B3-3-style pole is certified then.
PI_DECISIONS_FROZEN_2026_09_19.n: n=64. The strong regime label is not what we need now, and buying it with 128/192/256 seeds risks hours to resolve a small A-side contrast that is not required to determine the preferred composition.
PI_DECISIONS_FROZEN_2026_09_19.strong_regime_label: secondary, reported if it happens, never chased with compute
PI_DECISIONS_FROZEN_2026_09_19.seed_block: 20500001-20500064, subject to the registry confirming it free immediately before reservation

FROZEN_CLAIM_BOUNDARY_POLE_B.verbatim: The 6v6 composition sweep uses the certified 6v6 pole pair. Pole B is canonical SDS_PARENT_OP7, not the 4v4 B3-3 SDS2_B3_LOCKDEF10_2V1 construction. Therefore cross-scale differences cannot be attributed solely to team size.
FROZEN_CLAIM_BOUNDARY_POLE_B.attribution_rule: If 6v6 prefers a different composition than 4v4, we do NOT say 'scaling from 4 to 6 caused the change.' It could be team size, opponent construction, or their interaction. Any reading that attributes a cross-scale difference to team size alone is out of bounds for this record.
FROZEN_CLAIM_BOUNDARY_POLE_B.applies_to: every cross-scale sentence in the result, the reading, the tracker entry and any downstream record that cites this sweep

PREDECLARED_NEXT_STEP_BRANCH.clear_pattern: If the sweep shows a clear B-heavy composition pattern again, that is enough to design the 6v6 guarded composition strategy. Designing it is a SEPARATE freeze; this record does not authorize it.
PREDECLARED_NEXT_STEP_BRANCH.flat_or_chaotic: If composition is flat or chaotic at 6v6, STOP and reconsider before building another router. Do not proceed to a 6v6 router, do not raise n to rescue a flat result, and do not search compositions outside the seven.
PREDECLARED_NEXT_STEP_BRANCH.operationalizing_flat_or_chaotic: Reported, not gated: whether each pole's argmax beats the 3A/3D baseline with an interval excluding zero, and whether the argmax beats its runner-up. A pole whose argmax does not separate from the baseline is evidence for the flat branch. The judgement is the PI's.
